items.label: Extendable Pole Design
items.value: The optional extension pole makes the broom length from 38.18 to 50.39 inches, People can choose the appropriate length according to their height. And long handle allow you to Stand upright for comfortable sweeping. NO MORE BENDING!

items.label: Heavy duty Broom bristles
items.value: Upgraded four-row bristles design, high quality broom bristle construction, More dense and durable. Product is made from 20% recycled materials; packaging is 100% biodegradable. Kelamayi insists on working hard to protect the environment.

items.label: Easy Stand-up Storage
items.value: The clip-on feature makes the broom and dustpan upright a perfect space safer! Compact storage keep your home or work space clean and tidy. Works perfectly for multi-surface, Suitable for indoor use.

items.label: Self-Cleaning Dustpan Teeth
items.value: Built in scraper and comb/Teeth for easy to Clean Broom into Dustpan , Clean Pet Hair and Human Hair with one Pull on the Teeth. The rubber lip of the dust pan is flush with the floor and the teeth clean out the bristles easily.

items.label: Our mission
items.value: Make your live cleaner, and make your housework easier.
